directions.title: Taman kampus
directions.idea: CTA menyatu dengan jalur taman yang membentang sampai footer.
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website CTA + footer concept for GDGoC IPB, rendered as one polished flat website screenshot, 1600 by 1000 landscape, not a device mockup.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for cel-shaded low-poly/voxel campus landscaping, cream background, thin navy outlines, Chrome dinosaur. Do not copy its entire composition or show a full building. Design a NEW website footer.
Brand: Indonesian university tech community. Pixelify Sans-like large pixel headlines, Poppins-like highly readable supporting text, small JetBrains Mono-like labels. Warm cream #faf9f2 dominates the entire canvas, deep navy text, saturated Google blue/red/yellow/green accents, lively emerald/lime foliage, sunny cel shading. NO dark section or dark footer, no gradient poster, no glass cards.
The call to action and footer MUST be one continuous designed environment; no detached rounded CTA card above an unrelated link footer. Give typography abundant quiet negative space with legible scale. Main blue button stands out. Integrate low-poly 3D details and footer navigation into the same composition without overlapping text.
Text verbatim:
small eyebrow "JADI MEMBER GDGOC IPB"
main heading "Belajar bareng." then "Bikin karya bareng."
supporting sentence "Gabung komunitas mahasiswa IPB untuk belajar teknologi dan mengembangkan proyek bersama."
primary button "Gabung member" with simple arrow
small note "Lewat halaman resmi Google Developer Groups"
footer brand "GDGoC IPB"
footer brand descriptor "Google Developer Group on Campus" then "IPB University"
navigation "Tentang" "Program" "Instagram" "Kolaborasi"
bottom micro text "© 2026 GDGoC IPB"
Use only this text; no invented numbers, partner logos, testimonials, dates or extra headlines. No large fake logo. No additional explanatory labels or concept title in screenshot. Crisp beautiful editorial spacing.
Direction 1 — CAMPUS CONTINUATION. Upper half: left aligned eyebrow, 2-line pixel headline and readable copy, blue button. Right half: charming cream voxel Chrome Dino beside a saturated blue garden bench and small flowering tree. A cel-shaded landscaped campus path flows continuously across the lower third from left to right and gently becomes the footer's baseline. Lush diverse low garden beds, yellow daisies, pink bougainvillea, a small turquoise rectangular reflecting pool. The footer brand and navigation sit on the same cream canvas beneath the path, carefully spaced. Open composition, calm cream above, lively rich green garden below. Thin navy contours, warm directional light from right, soft crisp shadows, no dark outlines on paving. Distinctive art-directed scene with lots of breathing room.
